answer: WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts abundant in later gestation express genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (IL1R1), and collagen deposition (POSTN), which are highly expressed in pathogenic fibroblasts of fibrotic skin disorders.
support_quote: Notably, WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts expressed several genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (for example, IL1R1) and collagen deposition (for example, POSTN) (Fig. 3a,b), which are highly expressed in pathogenic fibroblasts of fibrotic skin disorders. These results provide further support for our finding of progressive acquisition of scar-promoting genes in later gestation, consistent with the clinical observation of scarring in third trimester skin.
